Title: Camarilla Vitae Slave Creature Type -  Putrescent Servitude

Messages.Author: Killiam
Messages.Body:
Question 1: Can Camarilla Vitae Slave be taken with Putrescent Servitude? In other words, is the CVS a mortal, ghoul, or something else?

Question 2: If CVS is something other than a ghoul or mortal, does that something have a name, or just "retainer"?

Thanks!
-Bill

Name: Camarilla Vitae Slave
[Sabbat:R, 25th:1, POD:DTC]
Cardtype: Retainer
Clan: Lasombra
Cost: 2 blood
Retainer with 1 life.
This vampire gets +1 capacity. During their master phase, they can choose a Discipline they have at inferior and get +1 level of the chosen Discipline until their next master phase.
Artist: Zina Saunders; Carmen Cornet

Name: Putrescent Servitude
[LoB:R]
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 1 blood
Discipline: Thanatosis
+1 stealth action.
[thn] Move any mortal or ghoul retainer you control to this vampire, or put this card on a mortal or ghoul ally you control. This ally gains 1 life, and he or she may play cards that require basic Potence [pot] as a vampire.
[THN]  As above, but take any mortal or ghoul retainer or put this card on any mortal or ghoul ally and take control of that ally.
Artist: Jeff Holt

-Killiam
(Bill Troxel)  "I look back from where I'm from
Look at the woman I've become
And the strangest things seem
Suddenly routine"
-Hedwig Robinson

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Killiam wrote:
> Question 1: Can Camarilla Vitae Slave be taken with Putrescent Servitude?
>
No.

> Killiam wrote:
> In other words, is the CVS a mortal, ghoul, or something else?
>
> Question 2: If CVS is something other than a ghoul or mortal, does that something have a name, or just "retainer"?
>
No subtype at all.
